decisions.preservation_method: digitally copy the recordings to modern storage media
decisions.access_policy: make the recordings available to all family members upon request

commitments.detail: Nora will ensure that all deteriorating tapes are copied to modern storage media to prevent loss.
Nora will store the digital copies in a secure location accessible only to authorized family members.
Nora will create a system for family members to request access to the recordings, ensuring that all can listen to them.
